leads.claim: When a state attribute or class toggles a property in CSS, declare the transition on the base selector and let the state rules set values only, because a transition runs on the after-change style, so one declared only on the hidden state animates the exit and pops the enter (and one on a child never fires when the state sets the parent's opacity).
leads.because: atlas lanes: the detail tiers' transition sat only under [data-band=0] and the run's on .al-run-line while data-dim set .al-run; a stylesheet test reading rules (comments stripped) went red on both and green after moving the transitions
